about: Vetted large files the gateway serves at GET {GATEWAY_URL}/assets/<sha256> (docs/CAPABILITIES.md, section 14). Each one is mirrored to Blob at assets/<sha256> by scripts/caps/mirror-assets.ts, which also fills in mirror. Licenses are checked before a file is listed. Empty since Nov 2: the only files were SpeechT5 text to speech and the ONNX runtime that ran it, and the organizers ruled that every model a project calls must be a Meta model. List no model file here that isn't Meta's.
